title: Sensor hardening and evidence quality
summary: Build on signed evidence prototypes while establishing practical quality, lifecycle reliability and bounded physical-device assurance.

goals.title: Signed evidence formats
goals.description: Implemented challenge-bound camera, microphone and location formats, with shared verification and explicit authenticity limits.

milestones.title: Signed camera, microphone and location formats
milestones.description: Implemented development boundaries include challenge-bound C2PA JPEGs, signed WAVs and request-bound COSE location traces. This milestone concerns formats and shared verification; it does not establish independent physical authenticity. The achievement date is unspecified.
acceptance: Camera, microphone and location records bind to their original request and independently pinned signer.
Verification keeps artifact integrity separate from physical truth and successful acceptance.

goals.title: Recorded GPS and audio trials
goals.description: The dated, bounded GPS retention recheck and local audio demonstration; wider physical reliability remains unverified.

milestones.title: GPS failed-attempt reports and exact retention checkpoint
milestones.description: The 5 October phone recheck retained a separately verified signed failure report and an unsigned pending journal snapshot with exact floating-point agreement after a controlled process restart. Crash and power-loss durability remain outside this milestone.
acceptance: Failed-attempt reports remain separate from successful location proofs.
Controlled restart preserves the observed signed and pending snapshots exactly without successful-measurement acceptance.

milestones.title: Local phone audio demo and independent saved-file verification
milestones.description: One authorized local phone demo completed on 6 October. The exact saved WAV was independently verified on 7 October against the retained media key. Requester provenance remains a local demo; independent physical requester acceptance and consistent acoustic reliability are unfinished.
acceptance: The local phone demo completes its pilot and challenged recording.
The exact retained WAV passes external verification and altered-input controls.

goals.title: Camera quality guidance
goals.description: Implemented unsigned JPEG guidance and the recorded deferred request for a single sharpness value.

milestones.title: Unsigned camera-quality guidance and saved-photo inspection
milestones.description: Resolution, exposure and regional sharpness indicators are implemented. On 5 October the phone analyzed an already saved JPEG; its exported unsigned report matched native Rust and WASM. This is guidance, with calibration and a unified requester value still open.
acceptance: Quality reports remain unsigned and cannot substitute for signed photo evidence.
The saved-photo phone export agrees with retained native and WASM results.

evidence.label: Camera quality guidance and phone result

milestones.title: Define the requested single 0–100 sharpness value
milestones.description: On 5 October the owner requested one user-facing sharpness value and one underlying algorithm. The source notes explicitly leave the algorithm undecided and implementation deferred. The existing unsigned guidance and acceptance rules are unchanged.

evidence.label: Recorded owner request and deferred implementation
